breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly does NOT treat the original x–y axes as principal directions. Instead, it properly applies the principal stress transformation formulas using the nonzero shear stress τ_xy = 3 MPa, computing R = sqrt((5)² + (3)²) ≈ 5.831 MPa and deriving σ_1 ≈ 10.83 MPa and σ_2 ≈ −0.83 MPa. This matches the ground truth approach, which omits the erroneous claim that principal stresses are simply σ_x and 0.
